units.source_text: 天色渐暮，薰君并不言归，大女公子甚是忧虑。

en.t: As dusk gradually fell, Lord Kaoru still said nothing of leaving, and the elder princess grew deeply anxious.

units.source_text: 弁君来向她传达薰君的话，并且代为不平，说他的怨恨是怪不得的。

en.t: Ben no Kimi came to relay Lord Kaoru's words to her, and spoke on his behalf with sympathy, saying that his resentment was only natural.

units.source_text: 大女公子一言不答，只是叹气。

en.t: The elder princess gave not a word in reply, but only sighed.

units.source_text: 她想：“我这一身今后如何处置呢？

en.t: She thought, "What am I to do with myself from now on?

units.source_text: 如果父亲在世，则听其安排，无论把我嫁给何等样人，都是宿世命定。

en.t: If my father were still alive, I would simply obey his arrangements; no matter what sort of man he married me to, it would be fate ordained from a former life.
To live in this world is, after all, to have one's body not wholly governed by one's heart.

units.source_text: 即使不幸，也是常例，不会受人非笑。

en.t: Even if it brought unhappiness, that would be the common lot, and no one would mock or blame me for it.

units.source_text: 此间所有侍女等人，年纪都较大，自以为聪明，扬扬得意地用适合自己身份的见解来向我劝说。

en.t: All the gentlewomen here are older, think themselves wise, and proudly lecture me with views suited only to their own station.

units.source_text: 然而都不是正道，只是奴仆之见，一厢情愿而已。”

en.t: Yet none of it is the right path; it is merely a servant's way of thinking, nothing more than their own one-sided wish."

units.source_text: 众侍女一味热心劝诱，但大女公子只觉得可恨可嫌，全然不为动心。

en.t: The gentlewomen kept urging her on with single-minded zeal, but the elder princess found it only hateful and repellent, and was not moved in the slightest.

units.source_text: 同她无话不谈的二女公子，对于男女之事比姐姐更不关心，一向悠然自若，因此不能同她商量此事。

en.t: The younger princess, with whom she could usually speak about anything, cared even less than her sister about matters between men and women and was always serenely unconcerned, so she could not consult her about this.

units.source_text: 她想：“我这一身何等乖戾！”

en.t: She thought, "How contrary and ill-fated this life of mine is!"

units.source_text: 只得一直背转身子，朝墙默坐沉思。

en.t: She could only keep her back turned, sitting silently in thought as she faced the wall.

units.source_text: 侍女们都来劝她：“请大小姐脱去了这淡墨色衣服，换上平时的服装吧。”

en.t: The gentlewomen all came to urge her, saying, "Please, my lady, take off these pale mourning robes and change into your usual clothes."

units.source_text: 她们都想在今天玉成其事。

en.t: They all hoped to bring the matter successfully to completion that very day.
The elder princess was in the greatest distress.

units.source_text: 其实，她们倘真要拉拢，有什么障碍呢？

en.t: In truth, if they were determined to bring the two together, what obstacle could there be?

units.source_text: 在这狭小简陋的山庄里，真是古歌所谓“山梨花似锦，何处可藏身”也。

en.t: In this cramped and humble mountain villa, it was just as the old poem said: when the mountain pear blossoms are like brocade, where can one hide?
